notes: render.py: full per-frame pipeline (§2.5): camera pose lookup, back-to-front stack compositing, SVG raster cache keyed on (sha256, w, h, CACHE_VERSION=1), per-layer DOF blur + depth fade, near-cull opacity, mask compositing with L2 rule, global post (vignette→grain→light_leaks→fisheye→color_grade, pinned order §2.7). SVG rasterization via rsvg-convert CLI fallback (§5.3, skia-python not available). encode.py: FFmpeg subprocess wrapper (-c:v libopenh264, -threads 1, stdin pipe RGBA, -movflags +faststart). Grain seeded from SeedSequence(seed).spawn(GRAIN_CHANNEL).spawn(n_frames)[frame_idx]. Determinism verified (byte-identical MP4s on two renders of same scene+seed). PIL 9.5.0 (Python 3.11, ytshorts env) installed for PNG I/O. scipy not needed (cv2.GaussianBlur used). rsvg-convert 2.62.1 available.
